children: Columbus Acquisition announced reconvened Extraordinary General Meeting on Sept. 28, 2026 with time and dial-in details.
Reconvened Extraordinary General Meeting set for 9:00 a.m. ET on September 28, 2026 at Loeb & Loeb LLP, 345 Park Avenue, New York.
Virtual participation available: U.S./Canada toll-free 1 800-450-7155; international +1 857-999-9155; conference ID 5870682#.
All other previously announced meeting information remains unchanged.
Definitive proxy statement filed with the SEC on August 19, 2026; investors urged to read it and related filings available at sec.gov.
